changes.description: The Tinuë Solver has a new Find Quiet Tinuës setting. Turned on, any search that finds no strict tinuë goes on to search every move.
With Find Quiet Tinuës on, a winning move is shown as soon as a tinuë is proven to exist, before its shortest line is found.
The Tinuë Solver's interactive mode no longer searches for quiet tinuës unless Find Quiet Tinuës is on, and ignores the Depth and Nodes limits.
